cryptotracker-dashboard-description: Known portfolio value, watched markets, synchronization health, and data-quality warnings.
cryptotracker-auth_denied-label: Authentication failed. Verify the configured username and password.
cryptotracker-data_partial-label: Some requested intervals are missing. Settings → Synchronization shows active work and cached coverage.
cryptotracker-disputed-label: Provider disagreement exceeds the configured threshold.
cryptotracker-unpriced-label: One or more holdings have no trustworthy observed price.
cryptotracker-cost_basis-label: Gain/loss values are informational portfolio estimates, not tax calculations.
cryptotracker-retention-label: Historical market points and derived snapshots are kept forever by default; Settings can apply a finite retention window.
cryptotracker-export-backup_notice-label: A portable ZIP backup supports selective application-data restore; it is not a transaction-consistent database backup.
cryptotracker-address_privacy-label: The selected external chain provider receives this public address.
cryptotracker-chart-empty-label: No cached data is available for this view yet.
cryptotracker-log_disabled-label: Logarithmic scale requires every visible value to be greater than zero.
